newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain to propose 4 pct industrial gas tariff cut.
newsitem.headline: Spain to propose 4 pct industrial gas tariff cut.

text.p: Spain's Industry Ministry is to propose a four percent decline in the industrial gas tariff to an upcoming cabinet ministers' meeting, a spokesman for the Ministry said on Thursday.
"The ministry will present to the cabinet meeting, probably on July 18, a proposal to reduce the industrial gas tariff by four percent" the spokesman told Reuters.
The cut will have immediate effect once approved by the cabinet and published in the official state bulletin.

The spokesman said the supression of part of the specific tariff -- a different rate paid by some industrial sectors -- had been agreed one month ago, and was not new, contrary to local press reports today.
A spokesman at Gas Natural told Reuters that it was aware of the government's plans to cut the industrial tariff, although the firm did not know by how much.
Gas Natural said it has called for the suppression of the different tariffs charged to firms, fixed according to the type of energy being substituted, in favour of an overall general tariff.
